title: Update Pacman mirrors with fasttrack
summary: Generate a new mirror list using the default settings and the 'fasttrack' option, which selects the fastest mirrors. This requires root privileges and should be followed by a system update.

steps.explain: Generate a new mirror list using the fasttrack option to select the fastest mirrors. This requires administrator rights.

rollback.explain: If the new mirrors cause issues, you can restore the previous mirror list from a backup if you have one, or manually edit /etc/pacman.d/mirrorlist. The page does not provide a direct undo command for this specific action.

warnings: After running this command, you must synchronize your database and update your system using 'sudo pacman -Syyu'.
